_doc: Rigs (design spec section 7, decision 16.8; systems/rigs.gd): modules fitted to Lumi's body at the workbench. One module per slot, swapped at the bench at no cost; a fitted module shows on Lumi's model. Rigs are function, never looks: the Locker's eleven look slots are separate and nothing here is a cosmetic piece. slots: [{id, name}] in panel order. modules.<id>: slot; name and desc (shown, translated); district = the city whose opening brings the module's plan to the bench (the plan arrives the moment the city opens, so the tool can be fitted before the flight); tool_for = the pollution kind this module is the tool for (that kind's gate in pollution.json names the module: without it fitted Lumi cannot work the kind at all); cost = {cubes, parts} to build it once at the bench (no cost = handed over with the plan: every city's tool is free, the price of a tool is the slot it takes); mods = {stat: multiplier while fitted}; adds = {stat: amount added while fitted}; floors = {stat: the stat is at least this while fitted} (the Plate Cutter cuts a wreck into bites Lumi can lift, so it stands in for Lift Strength 2; the Skim Skirt carries her over water). Stats are Lumi's own (patch.json stats: capacity, scoop_width, scoop_reach, scoop_rate, move_speed, carry_stack, cube_value_mult, detector_range, lift_class, hover_water) and five that are not upgrade stats: kind_<kind id> = Lumi's rate on that pollution kind; parts_yield = the chance of a part worth stripping from what she takes (more Parts, so more robots); crew_near = the bonus robots get for working alongside Lumi (robots.json proximity.bonus is multiplied by this); crew_radius = how far that bonus reaches (proximity.radius_m is multiplied by this). Every slot has one module that acts on the crew (decision 16.8): Guide Arm, Sorter, Relay Mast. part = how the module shows on the model (player/rig_parts.gd): shape = one of that file's part builders, color = its paint (hex). Prices are first values inside the city price cap (nothing above 4,200 cubes); the balance pass (M3-12) sets them with the crew numbers. study: the numbers of the rig study (tools/pace_sim/rig_study.gd), which scores every module in every city and fails when one module of a slot is the best fit in every city: walk_m_per_ring = metres of a round trip to the scale per ring of the city; press_s = seconds to press one bale; float_hex_share = share of the hexes that are water in a city that lists a floating kind; hand_scale_by_city = how much faster Lumi scoops and how much bigger her chest is in each city than at the start, from the upgrade tracks; lumi_hauls_share = share of her bales Lumi walks to the scale herself in each city (haulers take the rest); crew_by_city = robots at work in each city, in city order (the accepted crew sizes, docs/DECISIONS.md M3-20); crew_near_share = share of the crew that works within reach of Lumi; robot_units_s = units of waste one robot clears a second; parts_per_robot = Parts one more robot costs; parts_per_unit = Parts Lumi strips from one unit of waste; learn_share = share of a city's hand work done before Lumi has learnt its newest kind (while robots must leave it alone, so only her own tool clears it); weights = how much the study values cubes a minute, cleaning a minute and Parts a minute against each other in each city, in city order (each city sums to 1): cubes count most early; once the crew is large the city is restored by the crew, and Parts are what build it.

plate_cutter.name: Plate Cutter
plate_cutter.desc: A salvaged cutting head. Slices wrecks into pieces Lumi can lift. Narrow.

wide_sweep.name: Wide Sweep
wide_sweep.desc: A broad intake fan. Sweeps a wide path of loose junk, but only close up.

long_reach.name: Long Reach
long_reach.desc: A telescoping boom. Pulls junk in from far off and skims well from the bank. Thin beam.

guide_arm.name: Guide Arm
guide_arm.desc: A signal paddle. Robots working near Lumi get three times the boost from her. Her own scoop slows.

deep_hold.name: Deep Hold
deep_hold.desc: A bigger hopper bolted under the chest. Fewer trips to the scale. Heavy.

press_frame.name: Press Frame
press_frame.desc: Stiff press rails. Bales come out tighter and pay more. Less room inside.

mist_scrubber.name: Mist Scrubber
mist_scrubber.desc: A filter drum and spray bar. Turns the can's water into a mist that scrubs smog. The drum takes chest room.

sorter.name: Sorter
sorter.desc: A sorting tray. Picks out far more parts worth keeping, for more robots. Bales pay a little less.

sprint_coils.name: Sprint Coils
sprint_coils.desc: Rewound hover coils. Much faster over ground. They take a little chest room.

skim_skirt.name: Skim Skirt
skim_skirt.desc: A float skirt with a skimming lip. Carries Lumi over water and lifts slick off it. Slower on land.

tow_hitch.name: Tow Hitch
tow_hitch.desc: A bale rack on the back. Carries two more bales a trip. Slower.

soil_doser.name: Soil Doser
soil_doser.desc: A dosing bar under the hover ring. Feeds the cleansing plants that draw blight out of the soil. Slower.

relay_mast.name: Relay Mast
relay_mast.desc: A tall relay on the back. Robots much further away still get a boost from Lumi, and the detector sees further. Slower.
